summary: Tested public lessons, registration/session cookies, lesson detail, quiz/progress integration, mobile UI, and seeded admin login. Public lessons and registration work; authenticated quiz submission fails on the duplicate/idempotent response path.

critical.issue: Repeated operation_id returns HTTP 500 because the duplicate attempt lookup includes Mongo ObjectId _id, which FastAPI cannot JSON encode.
Required seeded admin editor@gakushu.local is rejected with 422 by Pydantic EmailStr because .local is treated as a special-use/reserved domain; admin cannot log in with the supplied credentials.

integration_issues.issue: The UI navigates back to the login page after the API returns 500, with no visible quiz error state.

action_items: Exclude _id in the duplicate quiz attempt lookup or return a sanitized response.
Allow the required seeded .local admin email through validation or change the seed contract consistently.
Add frontend lesson loading/error handling and show quiz API errors instead of redirecting unauthenticated-looking users.
critical_code_review_comments: Lesson and dashboard fetches do not provide catch handlers, so API failures leave silent loading/empty states.
service-worker.js exists but index.js does not register it, so offline shell fallback is not active.
seed_data_creation: Created one uniquely named learner through the public registration endpoint for regression testing; no seeded records modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public GET lessons/detail and new registration cookie session passed. Re-run duplicate quiz operation_id, admin login, forgot/change password, and PWA registration after fixes.
rca of the issue: submit_quiz catches duplicate-key insertion and queries attempts with projection {"_id": 0}; however the observed 500 occurs when the existing duplicate record is returned with ObjectId _id, indicating the deployed duplicate lookup path does not sanitize the Mongo identifier. Admin login fails before credential lookup because EmailStr rejects editor@gakushu.local.
